name: My COUSIN is a FEMBOY
source:
You haven't seen your cousin in, like, forever. You used to be so close and meeting up with him again after graduating high school has you very excited. Your families are meeting up for a holiday at the water park, and things are about to get wet... 😜

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2772480/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
你好像有一辈子没见到自己的表亲了。以前你们俩特别要好，如今高中毕业，想到又能见到他，你兴奋极了。两家人约好了一起去水上乐园度假，看来很快就要浑身湿透了…😜

（来源：[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2772480/]Steam[/url]）
